issue.title: Targeted defect fixes for the prompt_prose wire, update races, Telegram transport, bundle caps, and triage conflicts
issue.description: Host-produced artifact-link origins, including prompt_prose, round-trip through the real sase_core_rs binding, and a contract test fails on any future origin drift. Jobs and launches that overlap a code swap defer and retry instead of failing, an update-overlap reproducer guards that behavior, and a prebuilt-artifact cache miss is a miss rather than a failure. Telegram falls back to plain text only on entity-parse errors, retries per chunk without resending delivered chunks, reports credential and network outages once per state transition, and runs its outbound job only on the sending machine. Every provider root bundle fits its declared max_bytes through compile-time compaction, with a doctor check and a just-check test that catch growth. bead_task_triage recovers from request_id_conflict by advancing the generation.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md requests this work

issue.title: Build an update-overlap reproducer for jobs, launches, and native code
issue.description: swap_repro: a test-only harness simulates an install swap in temp dirs under a real code-swap writer lock. It drives vanishing scripts, a vanishing binding, mixed-version lazy imports, and in-place versus atomic file replacement. Still-failing modes become strict xfails for the guard phases. Record which modes reproduce and how the real installers replace files.

issue.title: Defer and retry scheduler jobs that overlap a code swap
issue.description: swap_chop_guards: the code-swap writer records a durable last-swap stamp. The chop runner does not start scripts while a writer is live, and it treats a missing script within a short post-swap grace as inhibited. A run that overlapped a swap and died of SIGBUS or a swap-skew import error is recorded as a skipped retry, not an error. Flip the chop xfails.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase swap_chop_guards as one work unit

issue.title: Defer and retry launches and finalizers that overlap a code swap
issue.description: swap_launch_guards: agent launches, bead work, and host finalizers that hit a missing binding or swap-skew import error during or just after a swap wait for it to end and retry. Long-lived processes stop mixing pre-swap and post-swap modules. Fix in-place native-code replacement only if the reproducer triggered SIGBUS. Flip the remaining xfails.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase swap_launch_guards as one work unit

issue.title: Treat a prebuilt Rust artifact cache miss as a miss, not a failure
issue.description: prebuild_miss: prebuild consume exits 0 and records hit:false with its reason on a cache miss. Dev-update reconcile records the step as a miss, then builds from source. The prebuild producer's writer probe also recognizes install.dev and install.pypi swaps.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase prebuild_miss as one work unit

issue.title: Fall back to plain text only on entity-parse errors and retry per chunk
issue.description: tg_transport: in sase-telegram, plain-text fallback fires only for an entity-parse BadRequest. Timeouts, network errors, rate limits, and credential errors reach the retry wrapper unchanged. Retries wrap each chunk, so delivered chunks are never resent, and the outbound job resumes a partly delivered notification at its first undelivered chunk.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase tg_transport as one work unit

issue.title: Collapse repeated Telegram credential and network failures into degraded states
issue.description: tg_degraded: outbound and receiver track a persisted credential_unavailable or network_degraded state. Each logs one line on entering a state, rate-limited summaries while degraded, and one line on recovery, with no tracebacks for transient errors. One SASE notice fires per transition. Credential lookups are negatively cached for a short window.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase tg_degraded as one work unit

issue.title: Compact oversize provider root bundles at compile time until they fit
issue.description: bundle_trim: when a provider declares max_bytes and the delivered bundle would exceed it, compile applies a deterministic compaction ladder. Step one drops summaries from superseded list-roster entries. Step two compacts whole list rosters, largest first. Bundles that already fit stay byte-identical, and no memory file changes.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase bundle_trim as one work unit

issue.title: Gate provider bundle sizes in sase doctor and just check
issue.description: bundle_gate: a sase doctor check renders every enabled project's root bundle for each provider that declares max_bytes. It errors over the cap and warns when compaction was needed. A just-check test keeps sase's own bundles under every cap without compaction. Update the instruction-bundle and Codex provider docs.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/defects_wire_swap_telegram_bundles_triage.md defines phase bundle_gate as one work unit

issue.title: Advance bead_task_triage's generation on request_id_conflict
issue.description: triage_conflict: when gate creation fails with request_id_conflict, bead_task_triage cancels any pending gate under the stale id and advances and persists the generation. It then recreates the gate in the same pass. Other failures keep the deterministic retry.

p = Path.home() / \".sase/logs/dev_update.jsonl\"
